caption: The drawing features two vertically split, oval-shaped wooden panels placed side by side, each with a dark, weathered brown surface. The left panel depicts a sailing ship with multiple masts and sails, detailed with fine lines and shading to indicate rigging. Near the stern of the ship, there is a small American flag visible, bearing red stripes and a blue canton. The hull of the ship is outlined in red. The right panel displays an eagle with outstretched wings and a detailed body, facing to the right. The eagle’s chest features a vertical red-and-white striped shield. Beneath the eagle, partially visible lettering can be seen, including the letters "BY" and part of the word "ADAMS." Both panels show signs of aging, such as cracks and worn edges, and the imagery is rendered in muted tones of gray, red, and blue, blending into the brown wood background. The panels are set against a plain, off-white backdrop, and no other objects or designs are present.
title: Tavern Sign
